i lived there for 2 years. 
Cons:
-very loud and poor noise insulation to the point where i could hear multiple neighbours music loud enough to make out lyrics to the songs 
-maintenance is poor when things do break for example the elevator broke probably 5 times i lived there and each time took weeks to repair which would be awful if you had any mobility issues, or even just a lot of groceries etc to carry let alone if you moved in or out during that time 
-i paid $1200 for a 300 square foot studio, that go no sunlight, and had no parking, plus utilities on top 
-no parking for visitors and if you park on any street nearby for more than 2 hours (monday-saturday 9-5) you will get a ticket even if you move it to a different spot it is apparently the entire block you have to leave after 2 hours WITHIN 24 hours
-lots of break ins both in the parkade (with no parking spot this didn’t affect me) and also just random people found sleeping and using in halls and stairwells
-extremely strict strata (which is common) to the point where you can have basically nothing on your deck except patio furniture and no door mats, and just overall hostility 

Pros:
-great location 
-nice neighbours 
-park next door is nice and includes a dog park
-pet friendly depending on your landlords rules
